decisions.statement: This reaches the calendar as Alan.
A start and an end are both a date alone or both a timestamp.
A start and an end each a date alone is a whole-day event.
The event this answers with is reported as JSON.
A whole-day event's end is the day after the last day the event covers.
A zone is an IANA name rather than a raw offset.
A whole-day event has no zone.
A recurrence rule is said once over for each rule rather than parted by commas.
Everyone attending is emailed unless the call says who to email instead.
A call that threw after the calendar took the event says the calendar took it.

definition: the command placing a new event and inviting everyone named on it
